title: How to do distributed locking
author: Martin Kleppmann
why: The GC-pause race, fencing tokens, the efficiency-vs-correctness framing and the critique of Redlock's timing assumptions.

title: Is Redlock safe?
author: Salvatore Sanfilippo (antirez)
why: The Redis author's point-by-point reply; read it right after Kleppmann's post to see both sides.

title: ZooKeeper Recipes and Solutions
author: Apache ZooKeeper
why: The official lock recipe with ephemeral sequential nodes and the predecessor-watch trick that avoids the herd effect.

title: The Chubby lock service for loosely-coupled distributed systems
author: Mike Burrows (OSDI 2006)
why: Google's lock service: coarse-grained locks, sequencers (fencing) and lock-delay, with lessons from running it in production.
